html:
core/locale/cyrillic-font.ts

Cyrillic font plumbing — Russian (ru) renders in Fira
Source src/core/locale/cyrillic-font.ts
UX surface Shared primitives every surface builds on — no direct UI.

Members

FIRA_STYLESHEET

Google Fonts css2 endpoint — Fira Sans in the weights the site sets.

FIRA_LINK_ID

Marker id so the stylesheet injects at most once per document.

syncCyrillicFont

Syncs the cyrillic font surface to the active locale: on ru the cyrillic-font class flips --font-primary to Fira Sans and its stylesheet is appended to ; off ru the class is removed so Fira Sans is never requested. <html lang> follows the locale's BCP-47 tag so assistive tech + crawlers see the real document language.

  • @param lang Active locale code (en, br, ru, …).
